alert.head: Coffee leaf rust has been reported in your area.
alert.tip: Check the underside of older leaves for orange, powdery spots. Nearest report: {km} km.
alert.tip_own: Check the underside of older leaves for orange, powdery spots. One report is from your farm.
alert.reply_hint: After checking, reply 1 if you found rust or 2 if none.
alert.forecast_head: Recent weather has favoured coffee leaf rust near you.

sms.template: PestWatch: Coffee leaf rust near you. {r} reports/{f} farms in {h}h. Risk {level}. Check leaves {when}. Reply 1=found 2=none
sms.forecast_template: PestWatch: Rust weather near you. Risk {level}. Check coffee leaves {when}. Reply 1=found 2=none

voice.template: Hello, this is PestWatch. {head} {counts} {risk} {action} {tip} If you find rust, press 1. If you find none, press 2. To hear this again, press 9. Again: {action}

reply.PEST_FOUND: Thank you. Your report helps protect your neighbours. Ask your extension officer or cooperative about approved fungicide and pruning; don't spray before you have advice.
reply.NO_PEST: Thank you. Please check again in 3 days.
reply.HELP: PestWatch: reply 1 = found rust, 2 = none found, STOP = stop alerts, EN/SW/FR = change language.
reply.STOP: You will no longer receive PestWatch alerts. Reply START to resume.
reply.START: Welcome back. You will receive PestWatch alerts again.
reply.UNKNOWN: Sorry, we did not understand. Reply HELP for options.
reply.REFERRAL: Thank you. Your lead farmer and extension officer have been asked to check your farm. Until then, please don't spray; keep a damaged leaf to show them.

ui.title: PestWatch Field
ui.tap_photo: Tap to photograph a coffee leaf (underside)
ui.demo_model: Demo model output (stand-in for the on-device TFLite model)
ui.no_camera: No camera? Run the model without a photo (demo)
ui.likely: Likely coffee leaf rust. Your report helps warn neighbouring farms.
ui.possible: Possible leaf rust, but not certain. On its own this is too weak to act on; PestWatch combines it with nearby reports.
ui.unlikely: No clear sign of leaf rust. Reporting healthy leaves matters too: it tells PestWatch what normal looks like.
ui.auto_sync: They will sync automatically when you're back online.
ui.upload_note: Only the model's result (~100 bytes) is uploaded, never the photo.
ui.no_status: No status yet. Sync when you have signal.
ui.quiet_text: No unusual crop disease reported near you.
ui.emerging: Emerging signal near {village}: {r} reports from {f} farms in 72 h.
ui.outbreak_near: Outbreak alert near {village}: {r} reports from {f} farms in 72 h.
ui.live_count: {n} live report(s) received by the network.
ui.inspect_q: Did you find rust on your coffee leaves?
ui.message_label: Or send a message in any language
ui.message_ph: e.g. found rust / nimeona kutu / j'ai trouvé de la rouille
ui.offline_reply: (answered on this phone; it will be sent when you have signal)
ui.last_updated: Last updated {when}. You are offline: showing the saved status.
ui.not_sure_text: The model can't tell clearly from this photo, so don't spray because of it. Show the leaf to your lead farmer or extension officer, or take another photo of the underside of the leaf in daylight.
ui.ask_person_btn: Ask my lead farmer / extension officer
ui.referral_msg: Please ask a person to check my farm

all_clear.app: All clear: no new coffee leaf rust reports near you for {days} days. Keep checking your trees once a week.
all_clear.sms: PestWatch: All clear near you, no new coffee rust reports in {days} days. Keep checking weekly.
all_clear.voice: Hello, this is PestWatch. Good news. There have been no new coffee leaf rust reports near your farm for {days} days. Please keep checking your coffee once a week.

scout.app: PestWatch needs your help: there are unusual reports near you. Please check 10 coffee trees today (look under the older leaves), then reply 1 if you find orange rust spots or 2 if none. Thank you for protecting your community.
scout.sms: PestWatch: Unusual reports near you. Please check 10 coffee trees today. Reply 1=rust found 2=none. Thank you!
scout.voice: Hello, this is PestWatch. There are unusual coffee leaf rust reports near your farm. Please check 10 coffee trees today, under the older leaves. If you find orange rust spots, press 1. If you find none, press 2. Thank you for protecting your community.
